notes.text: The sheet bears the author's dark number 30 at the upper left and the lighter foliation 68 in another hand at the bottom left. It continues the phrase propriété universelle and refers to morphisms from the written categorie topologique underlined Sigma into an ens. préordonné, with pré visibly inserted. Two cancelled drafts precede the live conditions a), b), c).

The manuscript describes the underlined b map as an immersion propre in a), gives a decomposition involving delta in the following display, and in b) writes an immersion à image localt rare with ie : intérieur vide. Condition c) states dim finie for connected components. The subsequent dimension argument and final framed Sigma_i-to-Sigma_ii statement are reported as the manuscript's claims; no proof of those claims was attempted in this page reading.

The local superscripts are kept separately: the definition's first star has six visible arms; the restriction-label and third definition-term marks are tilted dense ovals with short spurs and remain prime/star uncertain; the rare-map target is roof-like; the dimension target has crossed star branches; the final Sigma_ii exponent is a clear two-arm left angle. No identification among these written forms is supplied from mathematical expectation. The parenthesised degree groups are lower in the live a map and delta line, but lie on the local baseline in the live decomposition and b map.

Both draft blocks are cancelled. The first contains the doubtful a) toute flèche inversible ... une identité; the second contains a) L'application delta ... and the b example ending propre followed by FOUR points and one closing parenthesis. The actual stepped outline and three oblique strokes are drawn around typeset words and formulas; no extra horizontal deletion rules are added. There is no detached stop after cancelled fermé and no independent comma after cancelled identité. The c between conditions and une identité is a separate insertion.

The final frame is a detached upper stroke above a continuous U-shaped lower/side stroke, leaving gaps at both upper corners. Its formula contains a headed arrow with a raised tilde. The colon is outside the frame. In the last paragraph, dans and objets de are cancelled; the final cancelled word remains sont/est uncertain. The repeated second sur earlier in the argument remains live/cancelled uncertain because its long join is not separable as an independent cancellation stroke.

The transcription preserves unaccented singular categorie and the short forms ens., p.ex., imm., localt, ie, dim and déf with their observed punctuation. In the b condition, ie has no separate internal full stops and is followed by a colon; the final i.e. is separately pointed. All three words rare, intérieur and vide are singular in that condition. No authorial question mark or explicit verification request was identified on the sheet; the doubt marks in the return record unresolved ink.

coverage.macro_only_differences_ignored: Archive/scan markers and H's editorial number notes; equivalent emphasis/underline macros; equivalent arrow names where heads agree; ordering of subscript/superscript commands; equivalent empty-set commands; math versus text dim and equality-label fonts; inline/display wrappers and adjacent TeX-line placement of the same display-closing parenthesis. coverage.audit_coverage: Every insertion, actual cancellation, disputed cancellation state, lexical C/H difference, local doubtful formula, numeral, framed structure and less-than-high-confidence departure from C is covered. Tight boxes use positional comments for clipped adjacent baselines; B22 is expanded upward and across both lines of the strict inequality.
coverage.count_method: against_C/H compares the leading reading, including state and actual drawing geometry; adding or resolving certainty alone is uncounted.
